title: Forging a Heart
html:
Forging a Heart is a sub-quest of the quest ⁠Servant of None for  Karlach's origin in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3. Karlach's infernal engine needs repairing by an infernal mechanic, the nearest being  Dammon, who can be found at his makeshift forge in the Emerald Grove.

Objectives

Find infernal iron.
  • "Dammon, an infernal mechanic, told me to find some infernal iron. He might be able to repair my heart."
Talk to Dammon.
  • "Found some infernal iron! Maybe Dammon can use this."
Meet Dammon on the road ahead.
  • Repaired: "Dammon's upgrade juiced me up. But my engine's not stable yet. I should find Dammon again in Baldur's Gate."
  • Not repaired: "Got to this shadow-cursed horror but didn't take Dammon up on his offer to repair my heart. Maybe I can still find him in the city."
Talk to Dammon.
  • "Dammon was in the Last Light Inn! He could still help cool me down a little."
Find infernal iron.
  • "Dammon needs infernal iron to repair my engine. I'm on it!"
Talk to Dammon.
  • "Found some infernal iron - just what Dammon needs to tune me up."
Let Dammon sleep on an idea.
  • "Dammon needs a little time to sleep on another solution for me. I've got a good feeling about this."
Talk to Dammon.
  • "Dammon must've come up with something by now, right?"
Find infernal iron.
  • "More infernal iron needed. On it, boss."
Talk to Dammon.
  • "I've got everything I need! Dammon should be able to fix me, now."
Find Dammon.
  • "Dammit - Dammon's moved on. Hopefully I'll be able to find him in the city."
Talk to Dammon.
  • "Dammon's in the city! He should be able to repair my heart after all."
Quest Completed!
  • "Phew, this second upgrade feels incredible. Still extremely hot, mind - but incredible."
  • "That's that, then. Dammon said he can't do anything else for me. Says I'll have to return to Avernus. It isn't what I wanted to hear... but it is what it is."
  • "Never did enlist Dammon's help with my heart, but now I've got more important things to do - like save the city I love."
  • "Never did tune up this old tin can of mine, but now I've got more important things to do - like save the city I love."

Walkthrough

Karlach's engine can receive two upgrades from Dammon, who can be found in a new location during each Act: The Hollow during Act One, Last Light Inn during Act Two, and the Forge of the Nine during Act Three.

If the first upgrade is done in The Grove, then Dammon says he needs to think further on how he can help Karlach. He does not have a clear idea until after meeting up with him again in the Last Light Inn. If initially encountering Dammon at the Last Light Inn, both upgrades can be received after a Long Rest. If Dammon is not met before but then in Baldur's Gate, both upgrades can be received at the Forge of the Nine after a Long Rest.

Emerald Grove

Dammon examines Karlach's engine, and relays it might be repaired, but he needs some  Infernal Iron. During Act One, it can be found at the following locations:

  • Inside a chest in the basement of a house in Blighted Village at X: -434 Y: -370
  • Inside  Dror Ragzlin's Treasure Crates in Shattered Sanctum at X: 298 Y: 66
  • Inside a trapped chest, in a locked room in the Zhentarim Basement at X: 285 Y: -165
  • Purchased from or given by Stonemason  Kith in Grymforge at X: -662 Y: 375

Karlach can return to Dammon with the iron, which improves her condition, but does not completely stabilise it.

If Dammon dies (for example, during the raid on the grove), there are no other infernal mechanics available and the quest fails.

Last Light Inn

If Dammon survives Act One and the Shadow-Cursed Lands, he can be found at the Last Light Inn. He needs another piece of infernal iron to make more improvements; any remaining iron from Act One can still be retrieved at this point, otherwise more can be found in the Shadow-Cursed Lands:

  • In the Reithwin Mason's Guild at X: -106 Y: 17
  • Inside an opulent chest in the vault room near  Balthazar in the Gauntlet of Shar at X: -821 Y: -752.

This time, Dammon's repairs allow Karlach to safely touch others.

Lower City

During Act Three, Dammon can be found at the Forge of the Nine in the Lower City, to give one last tune up to Karlach's engine. He again needs infernal iron, which can now only be retrieved from locations in and around Baldur's Gate:

  • Found on the floor in Flymm Cargo's Basement at X: -1078 Y: 312
  • Carried by Steel Watchers in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate
